description: This file defines classes and methods for propagating activity correlation and distributed context information across grain call chains in Orleans. It includes abstract and concrete classes for handling outgoing and incoming grain call filters, managing activity sources, and processing trace context for distributed tracing.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationGrainCallFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class providing activity propagation logic for grain call filters, including activity source selection and processing logic.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationOutgoingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: A concrete class implementing outgoing grain call filtering, injecting activity context into outgoing requests.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationIncomingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: A concrete class implementing incoming grain call filtering, extracting activity context from incoming requests.

methods.name: GetActivitySource
methods.description: Determines the appropriate ActivitySource based on the interface type's namespace.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Handles activity tagging, exception handling, and stopping the activity during grain call processing.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Method in concrete classes to handle the invocation logic for outgoing and incoming grain calls.
